The '''DX-6 Ravager''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Several DX-6s were deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], where they were sent to the [[Dark Reliquary]].<ref name="TOR" />
